items.title: State the plain-file allowlist and the directory-shaped-leaf rule in both dev-memory decision documents
items.context: docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md and docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md. Match the wording of the L4 rationale in packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts and the assertions in packages/main/tests/red/red-dev-memory-material.mjs, so the docs, the rationale and the test describe one boundary. Do not restate build counts or other figures that live elsewhere.
